scene: The brass robot beeps cheerfully, offering you a glowing folded paper crane.
picture: Flat side-view along the level rooftop. On the far left sits a wicker scrap basket. The lanky boy in his orange vest and kite stands facing right. In the centre, the brass automaton holds out a glowing paper crane. To the right, a striped wooden launch ramp angles upward into the open sky.
shown: a glowing golden origami crane resting on the robot's flat metallic palm at centre
a blue blueprint poking out of a wicker scrap basket on the far left
a striped yellow wooden ramp sloping upward on the far right

variants.scene: The friendly metal bot presents a warm, shining origami bird with a gentle whir.
Golden light radiates from the paper crane balanced upon the robot's bronze palm.
Sunset breeze rustles your scarf as the robot holds out its glowing paper creation.
